analysis.title: Secure Vulnerability Remediation System
analysis.summary: A university implements a centralized vulnerability tracking system to manage findings from approved security assessments, enabling secure remediation workflows with role-based access control and audit logging.

assessments.explanation: The system must track vulnerabilities from approved security assessments across servers, applications, endpoints, and network devices.
Security analysts can review findings, assign remediation tasks to authorized administrators, record investigation notes, track status, and close findings after evidence review.
The system must enforce role-based access control, detect unauthorized changes, generate alerts, and maintain audit logs for all finding updates and administrator actions.
The platform provides a centralized dashboard, integrates with university identity services, supports multiple campus locations, and maintains security, reliability, scalability, and manageability.
